verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an email SaaS with a public API could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The evidence shows no such file, though: the probe for llms.txt on fastmail.help returned HTTP 404, OpenAPI paths also 404, and the general JMAP and API documentation is not agent-oriented. Since nothing delivers the story, no deduction clause applies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
